The R002 Definition also omits rhopgradient, gamma, speedsystem, and coefsound present in the bound official Poiseuille Definition precedent. Their absence is a static compatibility/completeness gap; the retained log specifically demonstrates rejection for hswl only.

The bound CSV has the declared seven-column header and 705 finite numeric rows, with strictly increasing unique times from 0 through 11.196636217394023 s. Its nominal interval matches TimeOut, and the Definition references this exact relative path. Since GenCase stopped at Definition parsing, this does not prove control-file copy or loading.
